description: Per-field highlight options, carried as the value of a Highlight fields entry (the map key is the column name). Any option set here overrides the top-level highlight option for this field.

type.description: Optional. Highlighter implementation: unified (default), plain, or fvh. The semantic highlighter is rejected.

fragment_size.description: Optional. Maximum characters per highlighted fragment. Capped server-side.

number_of_fragments.description: Optional. Maximum number of fragments to return for this field. Capped server-side.

fragment_offset.description: Optional. Character offset at which to start highlighting (fvh only).

no_match_size.description: Optional. Number of leading characters to return when there is no match.

boundary_scanner_locale.description: Optional. Locale used by the boundary scanner.

boundary_chars.description: Optional. Characters treated as boundaries by the chars scanner.

boundary_max_scan.description: Optional. How far the boundary scanner looks for a boundary.

max_fragment_length.description: Optional. Maximum length of a fragment.

max_analyzer_offset.description: Optional. Maximum character offset analyzed for highlighting.

phrase_limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of matching phrases considered (fvh only).

require_field_match.description: Optional. Whether only fields that matched the query are highlighted. Default true.

highlight_filter.description: Optional. Whether to highlight only fields that passed the query filter.

force_source.description: Optional. Whether to highlight from the original _source rather than stored fields.

tags_schema.description: Optional. Built-in tag schema (styled) for the highlight markup.

pre_tags.description: Optional. Opening tags wrapped around highlighted terms.

post_tags.description: Optional. Closing tags wrapped around highlighted terms.

matched_fields.description: Optional. Other fields whose matches also highlight this field (fvh only).

options.description: Optional. Opaque highlighter-specific options passed through to OpenSearch.

highlight_query.description: Optional. A separate query used to select the terms to highlight for this field.
